title: Dune: Part Three final trailer is out. India release on December 18
summary: Timothée Chalamet's Paul Atreides faces rebellion and conspiracy in the last chapter of Denis Villeneuve's trilogy.
image_credit: Representative photo: sand dunes, Thar Desert. Photo: Clément Bardot / [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dunes,_D%C3%A9sert_du_Thar.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0
body:
Warner Bros. released the final trailer for Dune: Part Three on October 27. It is the last chapter of Denis Villeneuve's sci-fi trilogy, starring Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya.

Set almost twenty years after Paul Atreides took over the Imperium, the film is based on Frank Herbert's Dune Messiah. It shows Paul as an emperor facing rebellion and plots against him, and drifting apart from Chani.

The film opens internationally on December 16 and in India on December 18, 2026.
